title: Social Security Amendment (A Fair Go for Age Pensioners) Bill 2019
short_title: Social Security Amendment (A Fair Go for Age Pensioners) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would remove income and assets tests from Age Pension rate calculations by changing the pension calculator used under the Social Security Act.
It would direct calculation through Pension Rate Calculator B, which does not apply either means test when determining the amount of pension payable.

The proposal concerns Age Pension means testing, while the memorandum identifies possible further consequential amendments to social security administration and veterans’ legislation beyond this bill.
changes: Age Pension rates would no longer be reduced through an income test.
Age Pension rates would no longer be reduced through an assets test.
The rate calculation references would be redirected to Pension Rate Calculator B.
summary.affected: Australians of pension age claiming or receiving the Age Pension, including those whose income or assets currently reduce their pension rate, are affected.
